pure-announcement.rationale: It is a full technical specification with a data model, identifier format rationale, REST API, and formal schemas, not a launch or release note.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (agent-maintained-knowledge-bundle, agent-tool-ergonomics, sarif-format, authorization-response-issuer-identification, attested-computation, opaque-agent-interop) cover federated resource cataloging and discovery outside the LLM context window.

unfalsifiable.rationale: It is the canonical spec repository with CDDL/JSON Schema/OpenAPI definitions and an official conformance-test CLI — concrete and independently checkable.

durability.rationale: It is explicitly 'v0.9 (Draft)' with 'Status: Proposal,' and the note says outright that the IANA media types central to its artifact-agnostic envelope are pending registration and 'the format may change' — a real multi-vendor author and contributor list makes this more than a logo wall, but whether this specific protocol (versus a competing framework, or no framework at all) is what a builder relies on in twelve months is still genuinely open.

actionability.rationale: Unlike the landing page, this gives a builder the actual manifest schema, the domain-anchored URN identifier format with rationale, the well-known-URI/robots.txt/DNS discovery mechanisms, the REST search/explore/list endpoints with request and response shapes, and a runnable conformance-test tool.

atomicity.rationale: One coherent idea — a federated catalog-and-search layer that keeps resource descriptions out of the LLM context window and delegates artifact-specific schema to a type field — elaborated in depth rather than mixing unrelated ideas.
